questions.prompt: Which of these countries have won the men's football World Cup?
questions.fact: Uruguay won the first World Cup in 1930, at home, and did it again in 1950 in Brazil's own stadium.

questions.prompt: Which of these are citrus fruits?
questions.fact: Yuzu is a Japanese citrus that shrugs off frost, which almost nothing else in the family can do.

questions.prompt: How long is a marathon, in kilometres?
questions.fact: 42.195 km, fixed in 1921 to match the 1908 London course from Windsor Castle to the stadium.

questions.prompt: How many players does a rugby union side have on the field?
questions.fact: Fifteen a side, eight forwards and seven backs. Rugby league plays thirteen.

questions.prompt: Which country is the croissant originally from?
questions.fact: The kipferl came from Vienna. Paris bakers turned it into the buttery croissant in the 1830s.

questions.prompt: Which spice is the most expensive by weight?
questions.hint: It is picked by hand from crocus flowers.
questions.fact: It takes around 150,000 crocus flowers, each picked by hand, to make one kilogram of saffron.

questions.prompt: Invasion confirmed. Dock at Wikiplanet Station and pull up its satellite feed.
questions.name: Barcelona
questions.fact: Cerda's Eixample cut the corner off every block so horse trams could turn. The octagons are visible from orbit.
